title: Merged cells grid ods 002
notes: real ODF spreadsheet merges (same covered-cell model as the odt merged builder, ODF 1.2 §9.4, under office:spreadsheet): two tables, each with exactly one merge: MergeRows has Top spanning two rows (covered:table-cell below), MergeCols has Wide spanning two columns (covered:table-cell to its right); covered: is the mandated prefix for the table namespace URI. The normative counter reads table:table=2. Reference text lists each surviving cell's text once in row-major order (covered cells carry no text).
